Package frc.lib.NinjasLib.swerve.gyro

Interface GyroIO

All Known Implementing Classes:
GyroIONavX, GyroIOPigeon2, GyroIOSim
public interface GyroIO
Hardware-agnostic interface for a swerve gyro, following the AdvantageKit-style IO pattern: implementations read the physical (or simulated) sensor and populate a plain GyroIO.GyroIOInputs data object each cycle, so higher-level code (see Gyro) never touches vendor APIs directly. Implementations include GyroIOPigeon2, GyroIONavX, and GyroIOSim.

    • update

      GyroIO.GyroIOInputs update()
      Reads the current sensor state and returns a fresh GyroIO.GyroIOInputs. Should be called once per robot loop cycle, typically from Gyro.periodic().
      Returns:
      the latest gyro readings

    • resetGyroYaw

      void resetGyroYaw(edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Rotation2d yaw)
      Re-zeroes (or re-references) the gyro so that GyroIO.GyroIOInputs.yawOffsetted reports yaw at the current physical orientation, without disturbing the raw GyroIO.GyroIOInputs.yaw reading.
      Parameters:
      yaw - the yaw the gyro should report at its current orientation
